The helper is `wouldExceedLimit` in `src/config/plan-limits.ts`. I searched the repo for every call to it, including re-exports and renamed imports, and found none of those. Seven application files call it:

- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` (two calls: the quota check and the plan-change check)
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` (issues per project)
- `src/server/services/project-service.ts` (projects)
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` (webhooks)
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts` (seats, checked against the number of invites)
- `src/server/services/attachment-service.ts` (storage in MB)
- `src/actions/billing/change-plan.ts` (checks current usage against the plan being switched to)

I left out the files that only call `getPlanLimits`, `getLimit`, `planAtLeast` or use `UNLIMITED`, such as the pricing pages, `use-plan-limits.ts` and `rate-limit.ts`. I also left out the two test files that call the helper directly, `tests/config/plan-limits.test.ts` and `tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts`, because I read "source file" as application code rather than tests.

ANSWER: src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/actions/billing/change-plan.ts
